QUOTE: "**Option A: compile time (zero overhead).** In the user config, enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_C`, `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, and define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO=my_calloc` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO=my_free`." and "`platform.c:16-19` says the compile-time macros take precedence, and when both are defined the runtime setter is compiled out entirely."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter, and says that defining the macros compiles the runtime setter out, which makes the two mutually exclusive.
